reason: Classified as a navigation/panel UI enhancement plugin because its documented purpose is to present the DSH sidebar as an on-demand overlay in constrained embeds, with controls for toggling and side switching plus viewport-safe popup and select adaptations.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH Web Shell 的侧边栏客户端插件，可在嵌入式窄幅场景下将侧栏以弹层方式按需打开并收起，并包含侧边切换与弹层/下拉定位适配。
summaries.en: This is a DSH web client plugin that turns the sidebar into an on-demand overlay for embedded narrow layouts, with side-switching controls and UI positioning adjustments for popovers and select interactions.

capabilities: Adds a runtime client-side UI layer that changes sidebar behavior to an on-demand overlay in the DSH web client.
Allows toggling sidebar visibility via a header control and switching sidebar slide direction.
Adjusts certain UI element positioning for fixed descendants, native select controls, and floating overlays to stay within view and match the host layout.

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a DSH web UI sidebar overlay for VS Code sidebar webview embeds, with an overlay whale toggle and non-layout-consuming collapse behavior.
README lists sidebar side switching and fixed-panel anchor rewrites (left/right) plus select replacement and popup clipping/translation behavior, indicating active DOM and layout manipulation.
package.json defines a DSH web client plugin (dsh.client.platform: "web") with a patch bundle entry, confirming injected web-client behavior.
